text: Fitzrovia Real Estate Inc. is constructing a 38-storey rental building at 85-91 Broadway Avenue and 198 Redpath Avenue. The site is bounded by Broadway Avenue to the north, Redpath Avenue the east, existing residential uses (178-192 Broadway Avenue) to the south and existing residential uses (75 Broadway Avenue) to the west. St. Monica Catholic School, St. Monica Child Care Centre and North Toronto Collegiate Institute, have all been notified of the construction staging plan and the developer has committed to holding information sessions with the schools. Transportation Services is requesting approval to close the south sidewalk and a portion of the eastbound lane on Broadway Avenue abutting the south side of the site for a period of 30 months to accommodate the construction staging and operations.
